# Basin

Basin is a no-code form backend that enables users to set up powerful, reliable forms quickly without writing server-side code.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/basin/.

## Actions

- **Create Form**: Create a new form in basin.
- **Create Form Webhook**: Create a new webhook for a specific form.
- **Create Notification**: Create a new notification webhook.
- **Create Project**: Create a new basin project.
- **Delete Form**: Delete a form.
- **Delete Integration**: Delete a form webhook integration.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a project.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a specific webhook.
- **Get Domains**: Retrieve a list of all domains associated with the account.
- **Get Form Details**: Retrieve detailed information about a specific form.
- **Get Forms**: Retrieve a list of all forms.
- **Get Project Details**: Retrieve detailed information about a specific project.
- **Get Projects**: Retrieve a list of all projects.
- **Get Submissions**: Retrieve all submissions for a specific form.
- **Get Webhooks**: Retrieve all webhooks associated with a specific form.
- **Update Integration**: Update a form webhook integration.
- **Update Project**: Update details of an existing project.
- **Update Webhook**: Update settings of an existing webhook for a form.
